title: Preselect Vs Select Events And Chrome
description: Separate preselect (rectangle/lasso drag) from committed select; preselect secondary = anchor minus preselect; preselectCancel on Escape; onPreselect/onPreselectCancel events in TS.
summary: Board area-select now keeps a single committed selection while dragging: WASM resolves Selected for preselect∖selection and Highlighted for selection∖preselect (committed selection uses Selected when idle). TS mirrors this via boardElementInteractionChrome, highlighted on BoardObject, Escape→cancelAreaSelect, preselectCancel emit, and syncPreselectionSilent no longer clobbers chrome via full scene push. Play markers pass selected/highlighted separately. Tests cover chrome split, Escape cancel, and interaction chrome helper.
